candidates.change_summary: Return a different bytes4 constant (zero) instead of the correct onERC721Received selector.
Return an arbitrary bytes4 constant (0x12345678) instead of the correct selector.
Return the ERC721 safeTransferFrom selector instead of the onERC721Received selector, giving a different non-zero return value.
Delete the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken is never set and remains address(0).
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken is set to the NFT address instead.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken always becomes address(0).
Delete the statement `nft = _nft;` so `nft` stays at its default value address(0) after initialization.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so the stored nft address equals the base token address instead of the passed NFT.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(0);` so nft is always zero after initialization regardless of the argument.
Replace the assignment of changeFee with a hard-coded 0 so the stored changeFee no longer reflects the _changeFee argument.
Delete the statement that assigns changeFee from _changeFee, leaving changeFee at its default value of 0.
Assign changeFee from the _feeRate argument (cast to uint56) instead of from _changeFee.
Delete the statement `feeRate = _feeRate;` so feeRate remains 0 after initialization.
Replace `feeRate = _feeRate;` with `feeRate = _feeRate + 1;` so the stored feeRate is one higher than the input.
Delete the `if (_feeRate > 5_000) revert FeeRateTooHigh();` check so initializing with a feeRate above 5000 no longer reverts and stores the value instead.
